Most of the holdings you'll see on the cap table are generic trusts/corps/holding companies.

You can track some of these, but not all. KYC (Know Your Customer) laws require some disclosure of who the beneficial owners of any entity are, but the emphasis is really on making sure the investor is accredited (HNW individual or entity that has the wherewithal to discern complex investments). Addresses are likely to be law offices or offshore.
